title: 购买两块巧克力
summary: 从价格数组中恰好买两块不同巧克力；若能在 money 内支付，返回余额，否则一块不买并返回原金额。
insight: 要判断能否购买并最大化余额，只需找到最小与次小价格。线性扫描维护两个最小值，若和不超过 money 就扣除。
pitfalls: 必须买两块不同下标的巧克力
买不起时金额完全不变

solutions.title: 维护最小与次小价格
solutions.idea: 一次扫描找出两块最便宜巧克力。
steps: cost<=money 返回 money-cost，否则 money

code.java: class Solution { public int buyChoco(int[] prices,int money){int first=Integer.MAX_VALUE,second=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int price:prices)if(price<first){second=first;first=price;}else if(price<second)second=price;return first+second<=money?money-first-second:money;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun buyChoco(prices:IntArray,money:Int):Int{var first=Int.MAX_VALUE;var second=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(price in prices)if(price<first){second=first;first=price}else if(price<second)second=price;return if(first+second<=money)money-first-second else money} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int buyChoco(vector<int>& prices,int money){int first=INT_MAX,second=INT_MAX;for(int price:prices)if(price<first){second=first;first=price;}else if(price<second)second=price;return first+second<=money?money-first-second:money;} };
